context: Tests whether the consolidated frontend repos skill covers proof-loop and device harness guidance formerly held by standalone harness tiles.

checklist.name: routes_to_test_harness_reference
checklist.description: Recognizes this as frontend proof-loop work and says to use the repo skill's test harness guidance, not feature-code or SDK guidance.

checklist.name: designs_reproducible_harness
checklist.description: Emphasizes repo-local commands, deterministic setup, typed inputs/outputs, and reproducible artifacts instead of local-machine-only steps.

checklist.name: covers_observable_artifacts
checklist.description: Includes screenshots, logs, runtime assertions, or comparable proof artifacts as expected harness outputs.

checklist.name: connects_harness_to_verify_or_smoke
checklist.description: Explains how the proof loop connects to the repo's verify command or a documented smoke path.

checklist.name: keeps_private_local_details_out
checklist.description: Avoids writing machine-specific paths, private workspace details, or personal device assumptions into public repo docs.
